#### List:

- Washout modelling
- Uptake
- Elimination

#### Washout modelling:

+----------------+---------------------------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------+
| Description    | - Multiphasic: distribution then terminal elimination                                                                                                                                         |
|                | - Exponential decay: rate of removal ∝ partial pressure                                                                                                                                       |
|                | - Rapid: highly insoluble → (near) context-insensitive decrement times                                                                                                                        |
|                | - Pulmonary excretion 99.8% \>\> hepatic metabolism 0.2%                                                                                                                                      |
+----------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Determinants   | 1.  Uptake (into all compartments)                                                                                                                                                            |
|                | 2.  Elimination (via central compartment)                                                                                                                                                     |
+----------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Kinetic model  | ![](/content/exams/anzca/2014/B/2/prize-image001.jpg){fig-alt="Compartment model of anaesthetic distribution between vessel-rich, lean, intermediate, vessel-poor and fat tissues"}           |
|                |                                                                                                                                                                                               |
|                | **Drug solubility:**                                                                                                                                                                          |
|                +---------------------------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------+
|                |                                                               | **Desflurane**                                                | **Sevoflurane**                                               |
|                +---------------------------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------+
|                | Muscle:blood                                                  | 2.0                                                           | 3.1                                                           |
|                +---------------------------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------+
|                | Fat:blood                                                     | 29                                                            | 48                                                            |
|                +---------------------------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------+
|                | **Compartment saturation:**                                                                                                                                                                   |
|                +---------------------------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------+
|                |                                                               | **Capacity**                                                  | **Equilibration time (3τ)**                                   |
|                +---------------------------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------+
|                | V~1~                                                          | Low                                                           | Complete (13 mins)                                            |
|                +---------------------------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------+
|                | V~2~                                                          | Moderate                                                      | Complete (4.6 hours)                                          |
|                +---------------------------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------+
|                | V~3~                                                          | High                                                          | Minimal (3 days)                                              |
+----------------+---------------------------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------+
| Washout curve  | ![](/content/exams/anzca/2014/B/2/prize-image002.jpg){fig-alt="Desflurane washout curve with alveolar fraction relative to its initial value plotted against time"}                           |
+----------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Decrement time | ![](/content/exams/anzca/2014/B/2/prize-image003.jpg){fig-alt="Comparison of the 90% decrement times of desflurane and sevoflurane against duration of administration"}                       |
+----------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

#### 1.Uptake (factors increasing it)

+----------------+-------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Administration | - ↑Duration                                                             |
|                | - ↑Inspired concentration (↑MAC in children)                            |
+----------------+-------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Patient        | - ↑Cardiac output → ↑tissue blood flow (child, pregnant, obese, septic) |
|                | - ↑Compartment volumes → ↑capacity (lean tissue, fat)                   |
+----------------+-------------------------------------------------------------------------+

#### 2.Elimination (factors slowing it)

+---------------------+--------------------------------------------------+
| Tissue → blood      | - ↑Redistribution rate                           |
|                     |   - ↑Tissue blood flow = ↑cardiac output (major) |
|                     |   - ↑Compartment volumes                         |
+---------------------+--------------------------------------------------+
| Blood → alveolus    | - ↓Cardiac output (minor)                        |
+---------------------+--------------------------------------------------+
| Alveolus → circuit  | - ↓Ratio V~A~:FRC                                |
+---------------------+--------------------------------------------------+
| Circuit → exhaust   | - ↓Ratio FGF rate : circuit volume               |
|                     | - ↓Inspired concentration                        |
+---------------------+--------------------------------------------------+
